description: Convert dotenv files to JSON and back, with dotenv-compatible quoting, escapes, comments, export prefixes and multi-line values, plus validation warnings. Operations: "to-json" — Parse a .env file into a JSON object (last duplicate wins).; "to-env" — Write a JSON object as .env lines, quoting values only where needed.; "validate" — Lint a .env file: duplicates, invalid names, unterminated quotes, stray # comments.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: to-json: The .env file contents. to-env: A JSON object; nested objects are flattened (DB__HOST). validate: The .env file contents.

operation.description: to-json — Parse a .env file into a JSON object (last duplicate wins). to-env — Write a JSON object as .env lines, quoting values only where needed. validate — Lint a .env file: duplicates, invalid names, unterminated quotes, stray # comments.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

coerceTypes.description: Turn true/false/null and plain numbers into JSON types. Used by: to-json.

exportPrefix.description: Prefix lines with export. Used by: to-env.

indent.description: JSON indent in spaces. Used by: to-json.

separator.description: Separator for nested keys. Used by: to-env.

sortKeys.description: Sort keys alphabetically. Used by: to-env.

name: env-json
title: .env to JSON Converter
